name: gpuwm-hex
summary: MPAS-Atmosphere v8.4.2 and NOAA's hrrrv5 (RRFS-MPAS) configuration on NVIDIA GPUs: bit for bit against native MPAS-A and the patched native RRFS-MPAS on the measured cases (exact mode, strict numerics), with the tangent-linear and adjoint of the exact-mode hrrrv5 forecast (12 km example on a 32 GB card of compute capability 12.0).
